strengths.name: Ambition
strengths.description: Sets lofty goals and pursues them relentlessly.

strengths.name: Assertiveness
strengths.description: Firm conviction in speech and action.

strengths.name: Bravery
strengths.description: Remarkable courage in the face of danger.

strengths.name: Camaraderie
strengths.description: A deep sense of fellowship and loyalty to companions.

strengths.name: Caution
strengths.description: Prudence and forethought. Looks before leaping, plans before acting.

strengths.name: Certainty
strengths.description: Absolute confidence in one's understanding of the Force.

strengths.name: Charity
strengths.description: Willing to give time, resources, and energy to those in need.

strengths.name: Clarity
strengths.description: Mental precision and clear-headedness.

strengths.name: Cleverness
strengths.description: Quick-witted and resourceful. Finds creative solutions to problems.

strengths.name: Compassion
strengths.description: A deep capacity for empathy and concern for others' suffering.

strengths.name: Confidence
strengths.description: Strong self-assurance without arrogance. Trusts their own abilities and decisions.

strengths.name: Consideration
strengths.description: Thoughtful and deliberate in all dealings.

strengths.name: Consistency
strengths.description: Reliable and steady. Others know exactly what to expect.

strengths.name: Conviction
strengths.description: Unshakeable belief in a chosen path or principle.

strengths.name: Curiosity
strengths.description: An insatiable drive to understand the unknown.

strengths.name: Dedication
strengths.description: Total commitment to a chosen cause, person, or goal.

strengths.name: Discipline
strengths.description: Iron self-control and mental fortitude.

strengths.name: Empathy
strengths.description: An intuitive understanding of others' emotional states.

strengths.name: Enthusiasm
strengths.description: Infectious energy and optimism.

strengths.name: Fondness
strengths.description: Deep affection for friends, companions, and the people encountered.

strengths.name: Frugality
strengths.description: Careful stewardship of resources. Wastes nothing, plans ahead.

strengths.name: Honor
strengths.description: A personal code of conduct that governs behavior.

strengths.name: Humility
strengths.description: Genuine modesty about one's abilities and accomplishments.

strengths.name: Idealism
strengths.description: A sincere belief that the galaxy can be better.

strengths.name: Independence
strengths.description: Self-reliance and personal autonomy.

strengths.name: Joy
strengths.description: A wellspring of happiness that persists even in dark times.

strengths.name: Justice
strengths.description: A deep commitment to fairness and accountability.

strengths.name: Love
strengths.description: An open heart and genuine affection for others.

strengths.name: Malleability
strengths.description: Flexibility and openness to new ideas.

strengths.name: Mercy
strengths.description: The capacity for forgiveness and restraint.

strengths.name: Modesty
strengths.description: Understated and unpretentious.

strengths.name: Patience
strengths.description: Willing to wait for the right moment.

strengths.name: Pride
strengths.description: A healthy sense of personal worth and accomplishment.

strengths.name: Reason
strengths.description: Logic and rational analysis guide decision-making.

strengths.name: Righteousness
strengths.description: A burning sense of moral correctness.

strengths.name: Sympathy
strengths.description: A natural capacity to share in others' pain and joy.

strengths.name: Trust
strengths.description: A willingness to believe in others' good intentions.

strengths.name: Wellness
strengths.description: Commitment to physical, mental, and spiritual health.

strengths.name: Wonder
strengths.description: A profound sense of awe at the galaxy's vastness and mystery.

weaknesses.name: Alienation
weaknesses.description: Withdraws from the company. Connection feels unfamiliar, and the isolation begins to seem deserved.

weaknesses.name: Anger
weaknesses.description: Answers provocation with force, then finds the justification afterward.

weaknesses.name: Antipathy
weaknesses.description: Finds the defect in every good thing, and treats the contentment of others as something to correct.

weaknesses.name: Apathy
weaknesses.description: Weighs the crisis, decides it belongs to someone else, and returns to what they were doing.

weaknesses.name: Arrogance
weaknesses.description: Is not satisfied by success unless someone else has fallen short of it.

weaknesses.name: Closed-mindedness
weaknesses.description: Settled the question long ago and stopped listening at the same time.

weaknesses.name: Cold-Heartedness
weaknesses.description: Registers the suffering of others without feeling any claim from it.

weaknesses.name: Coldness
weaknesses.description: Has hardened self-reliance into indifference. If another cannot manage, that is their concern.

weaknesses.name: Condemnation
weaknesses.description: Measures others by what they spend, and finds them wanting.

weaknesses.name: Condescension
weaknesses.description: Helps with visible reluctance, explaining what nobody asked to have explained.

weaknesses.name: Conformity
weaknesses.description: Defers in order to belong, and buys fellowship at the cost of independent judgment.

weaknesses.name: Confusion
weaknesses.description: Loses the thread of events and seizes on whatever certainty lies nearest.

weaknesses.name: Cruelty
weaknesses.description: Takes pleasure in punishment, then declares it deserved.

weaknesses.name: Defiance
weaknesses.description: Resists on principle, including help the character genuinely needs.

weaknesses.name: Demanding
weaknesses.description: Extends warmth and expects repayment for it.

weaknesses.name: Desperation
weaknesses.description: Seizes any remedy at any cost, and seizes it now.

weaknesses.name: Disarray
weaknesses.description: Scatters obligations and brings little of them to completion.

weaknesses.name: Disdain
weaknesses.description: Holds most people and most proposals beneath consideration.

weaknesses.name: Dogmatic
weaknesses.description: Keeps the rule long after the reason for it has gone.

weaknesses.name: Egoism
weaknesses.description: Is certain of one thing only: their own precedence.

weaknesses.name: Fear
weaknesses.description: Sees the risk clearly and withdraws from it, every time.

weaknesses.name: Greed
weaknesses.description: Wants power, wealth and comfort, and then more of each.

weaknesses.name: Guardedness
weaknesses.description: Has withdrawn trust and not restored it, keeping the defenses raised even toward allies.

weaknesses.name: Hatred
weaknesses.description: Witnessed suffering and turned it into loathing that does not diminish.

weaknesses.name: Hesitancy
weaknesses.description: Deliberates without end and decides never.

weaknesses.name: Impatience
weaknesses.description: Forces the moment and damages what needed time.

weaknesses.name: Indecision
weaknesses.description: Keeps every option open by never selecting one.

weaknesses.name: Intolerance
weaknesses.description: Reads difference as defect, and has no patience for other ways of proceeding.

weaknesses.name: Jealousy
weaknesses.description: Envies what others possess, and whom else is loved.

weaknesses.name: Judging
weaknesses.description: Delivers the verdict first and treats the evidence as optional.

weaknesses.name: Martyrdom
weaknesses.description: Makes certain the sacrifice is witnessed, and treats it afterward as a credential.

weaknesses.name: Mercilessness
weaknesses.description: Gives no quarter under any circumstance. The defeated are finished rather than spared.

weaknesses.name: Naivety
weaknesses.description: Trusts the galaxy to be better than it is.

weaknesses.name: Naïveté
weaknesses.description: Accepts the galaxy at face value and absorbs the difference.

weaknesses.name: Obsession
weaknesses.description: Lets one interest eclipse all others, and cannot set it down.

weaknesses.name: Obstinacy
weaknesses.description: Holds the position because it is the position they hold.

weaknesses.name: Obstinence
weaknesses.description: Will not correct course and will not hear a second opinion.

weaknesses.name: Recklessness
weaknesses.description: Commits first and reckons the cost afterward.

weaknesses.name: Repression
weaknesses.description: Suppresses what they feel until it governs them from within.

weaknesses.name: Rigid
weaknesses.description: Reads any deviation as a threat, and treats routine as the only safe ground.

weaknesses.name: Sophism
weaknesses.description: Builds arguments to prevail rather than to be true.

weaknesses.name: Sorrow
weaknesses.description: Persistent grief that informs someone's actions.

weaknesses.name: Spite
weaknesses.description: Keeps accounts and settles them in small increments.

weaknesses.name: Vanity
weaknesses.description: Tends to the appearance more carefully than the substance.

weaknesses.name: Vengeance
weaknesses.description: Empathy for the wronged sharpened into an instrument against the wrongdoer.

weaknesses.name: Weakness
weaknesses.description: Tolerates wrongs because confronting them is difficult.

weaknesses.name: Weariness
weaknesses.description: Finds effort spent before it begins, and has been depleted past caring.

weaknesses.name: Worthlessness
weaknesses.description: Is persuaded of their own insignificance, and acts upon it.
